label: preparing
what: Refreshments for the civic hospitality/community-gathering event: ordered 120 loaves and later 80 additional loaves. The mayor was not initially informed of the preparations; bakery work and delivery were underway. Baker and freight knowingly assisted with baking/supply and transport, while builder and innkeeper were organizers/participants. The record does not establish that this was concealed from the mayor intentionally, and the baker/freight's exact roles in the original order/payment remain partly unclear.
